obfuscation_indicators: cash flow ... adequate to sustain operations
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified but highlights material deterioration, including a 32.1% revenue decline, a 44.9% gross-profit decline, a larger net loss, and reduced cash and working capital. Management emphasizes cyclical demand and customer inventory adjustments while relying on forward-looking growth opportunities and an unquantified forecast of liquidity adequacy through 2017.
